scoring_guide.title: How SP investment scoring works
scoring_guide.intro: Point-sum heuristic inspired by eternalsp’s SP/SSP suggestion list. Not a damage calculator. Raw points convert to a letter and a suggestion bucket. Axes marked heuristic use judgment rules, not datamined facts.
overrides: Dual terrain: Space + Land (Ground) deploy, +2 (changelog override).
GN Field / Positron Reflector passives award no ability points.
Top weapon power tier starts at 5800.
gaps: Letter cutoffs are provisional; build also applies within-role percentile soft uplift (absolute_plus_role_percentile).
Ability “great for role” and linked-pilot quality are heuristic.
Debuff “level” 3–6 is mapped from DEF-debuff % bands.
Letters use absolute cutoffs, then within-role percentile soft uplift (calibration=absolute_plus_role_percentile).
